# Corpus Mining: "The Black Book 5" — IDENTIFIED AS: Ra Uru Hu, *The Human Design System* (1991/1992)

**Source PDF**: `/mnt/agents/upload/pdfcoffee.com_the-black-book-5-pdf-free.pdf` (126 pp, poor OCR of the 1992 München printing)
**Identification**: **"The Human Design System — An Introduction" by Ra Uru Hu** (Alan Robert Krakower), published by New Sun Services Ibiza, © Ra Uru Hu 1991, printed München 1992. This is the foundational **"Black Book" of the Human Design cult** — the author claims the system was dictated by "a Voice" over eight days and nights beginning 3 January 1987 on Ibiza (Foreword).
**Is it I Ching?** — Not classical I Ching scholarship, but it is **I Ching-derived**: its core is the "Rave I Ching", a re-mapping of the 64 hexagrams onto an astrological wheel and a chakra body-graph. It is directly relevant as a *modern invented symbol-system* built on the 64-state space.
**Contents (TOC)**: Foreword · The Human Design System — Introduction · The Rave Charts (p. 11) · The Rave I Ching Astrological Index (p. 33) · The Rave I Ching (p. 41) · The Juxtaposition Unified Theory (JUT) (p. 107) · Blank Charts (p. 123). OCR is degraded ("1" for I, etc.); quotes below are cleaned where obvious, marked where uncertain.

---

## 1. PRIMITIVES

### 1.1 Cosmogonic primitives (JUT, pp. 107ff; Introduction pp. 1–4)
- **Two "Crystals"**: Yang Crystal (in the seed) and Yin Crystal (in the egg) — shattered at the Big Bang (= conception); "It is these Crystals which are at the core of what we call life." Existence of the crystals "has not been proven" — admitted "mystical component".
- **Six Quarks** (Up, Down, Strange, Charm, Beauty/Truth) → grouped as Proton/Neutron; **six Leptons** → Electrons + Neutrinos.
- **The Neutrino stream** as information carrier: "Three trillion Neutrinos penetrate through everything, everywhere, every second... It is a data stream and within each of us exist particles which connect us to the stream."
- **The Magnetic Monopole**: "a magnet, but one with only one pole. It only attracts and has no capacity to repel." (function: holds personality+design together in one life).
- Synthesis claim: "The Rave Chart incorporates the I Ching... the Chakra energy system and Lunar Astrology from India; Arabian Stellar Astrology; the Kabbalah; Western Astrology; Physics; Astronomy; Biology; and Chemistry."

### 1.2 The Rave Chart primitives (The Rave Charts, pp. 11–32)
- **Two wheels + one "triangle"** (the Body Graph): "The Rave is made up of two wheels and a triangle."
  - **Personality wheel**: calculated for exact time/location of birth (as in Western natal astrology).
  - **Design wheel**: "a calculation made three months before birth." (In later Human Design this becomes the 88°-before-birth calculation; here stated as three months.)
- **Zodiac ring**: 12 signs × 30°; outside it, the **64 hexagrams as "Constellations"**: "Each Constellation/Hexagram takes up **5°37'30"** of arc. These divisions divide the circle into specific fields of energy."
- **Hexagram order on the wheel is NOT King Wen order** — it is a zodiacal sequence (the "Rave wheel"). Astrological Index sample (p. 33f): Aries contains gates **17 (Following/Opinions), 21 (Biting Through, "The Money Line"), 51 (The Arousing), 42 (Increase)**; Taurus contains **27 (Nourishment), 24 (Returning), 2 (The Receptive), 23 (Splitting Apart)**, etc. [OCR; gate numbers as printed]
- **Six lines per gate, each line = 56'15" of arc**, listed to the second (e.g. Gate 1 spans 13°15'00"–18°52'30"; line 1 = 13°15'00"–14°11'15", line 2 = 14°11'15"–15°07'30", ...).
- **64 Gates**: each hexagram = a "Gate" seated in one of the centers (e.g. "A Gate - 47 Oppression").
- **32 Channels** (this 1991 count): "The Rave Body Graph has nine centers. These centers are connected to each other through thirty-two channels (based on the Sephiroth of the Kabbalah)." [Later HD canon says 36 channels; this first edition says 32 — as printed.]
- **Harmonic Gate**: the gate at the other end of a channel; two harmonic gates together define a channel (e.g. Gate 11 + Gate 56 → "Channel 11-56 Curiosity. The design of the searcher").
- **Definition**: centers "permanently connected" (defined) vs undefined; "The circuitry revealed in the Body Graph... does not change... life is not something that we change but rather that life changes us."

### 1.4 Gate-entry template (The Rave I Ching, pp. 41–106) — the per-hexagram slot grammar
Each of the 64 entries has a fixed record structure (example: Gate 1 "The Creative", p. 41):
- **Sign**: zodiac sign + quality + 3 keynotes — "Scorpio-Fixed. Transcendence Sex Death Regeneration"
- **Center + keynotes** — "G Center. Spirituality Gravity Attraction Love"
- **Biology** (organ) — "The Liver"
- **Gate number + name** — "Gate: 1 The Creative"
- **Harmonic Gate** — "8 Holding Together"
- **Channel + channel keynote** — "Channel: 1-8 Inspiration. The creative Role Model"
- **Thesis line** (the hexagram's theme) — "Creation as a primal force. The energy potential to manifest inspiration without limitation."
- **Six lines**, each: ordinal + keynote sentence + **planet "exalted"** (positive pole) + **planet "in detriment"** (shadow pole) + gloss. E.g. 1/1: "Creation is independent of will. The Moon exalted as a symbol of adeption... Uranus in detriment. Instability leads to distortion."
- Duality rule: "'exalted' and 'detriment'... express the duality of the energy of each line. It is not simply a matter of good or bad... but an expression of the energy's range." (p. 20)
- Yin/yang spectrum statement: "The sixty-four Hexagrams are divided into two groups of thirty-two. From absolutely Yin (The Receptive 2) to the absolutely Yang (The Creative 1) the entire spectrum of energy is covered." (p. 20)

### 1.5 Line-keynote vocabulary (samples, from Astrological Index + Rave I Ching)
Gate 42 lines: Diversification / Identification / Trial and Error / The Middle Man / Self-actualization / [6th OCR-lost]. Gate 2 lines: Intuition / Genius / Patience / Secretiveness / Intelligent application / Fixation. Gate 24 lines: The Sin of Omission / Recognition / The Addict / The Hermit / Confession / The Gift Horse. Gate 51 lines: Reference / Withdrawal / Adaptation / Limitation / Symmetry / Separation. (i.e. each line receives a fixed archetypal keyword — a modern parallel to the bronze-age per-line oracle, but semantized rather than omen-based.)

## 2. RULES

R1. Wheel rule: 64 gates × 5°37'30" = 360°; 6 lines × 56'15" per gate. (geometry)
R2. Two-wheel rule: Personality (birth moment) + Design (~3 months before birth); both imprint gates. (generation)
R3. Activation rule: a planet falling in a gate "opens" that gate; two harmonic gates opened (by either wheel) complete a channel → defines both centers. ("When a position of a planet is calculated for one of the wheels, placing it in a specific Hexagram, this [opens the Gate]")
R4. Definition rule: defined centers/channels are fixed for life; undefined centers are fields of change through transits and other people. ("There are centers which are permanently connected and therefore defined. There are also centers that are not permanently connected.")
R5. Line-duality rule: every line = keynote + exalted planet + detriment planet (bipolar valuation).
R6. Center-biology mapping rule: each center coordinates "information from the Crystals" and transfers it "to the Glands... translated into the chemical language of our bodies."
R7. Polarity spectrum rule: 64 gates = 32 yin + 32 yang spanning from Hex 2 (all yin) to Hex 1 (all yang).
R8. Synthesis rule: interpretation "is an act of Synthesis. The Hexagrams of the I Ching are the synthesizing medium."

## 3. SYNTAX/STRATA OBSERVATIONS

- The system **re-indexes the 64-state space by celestial longitude** rather than by the received order: the hexagram becomes a slice of the ecliptic; the line becomes a sub-degree slice. This is the inverse of the Zhouyi stratum (omen-text attached to figure): here *positional geometry is primary* and text (keywords) is generated from position.
- The Zhouyi text (judgments/line statements) is entirely absent; hexagram names follow the Wilhelm-style tradition (The Creative, The Receptive, Difficulty at the Beginning, Youthful Folly...). Each gate's six lines receive **new authored keynotes**, not translations.
- Triple correspondence lock per gate: **zodiac sign ↔ body center/gland ↔ partner gate/channel** — a 3-way join over the 64 states.
- Line valuation = planet polarity (exalted/detriment) — structurally parallel to the Zhouyi prognostic slot (ji/xiong bipolar valuation) but mapped to planets rather than moral fortune.

## 6. UNCERTAINTIES
- OCR quality is poor; some center glands/colors (items 4–8) and a few line keynotes could not be cleanly recovered. What is quoted above is verified text.
- The 32-channel count is what this 1991 first edition prints; later Human Design canon uses 36 — an internal evolution of the system.
- Gate wheel order sampled only for Aries/Taurus segment of the Astrological Index; full 64-gate wheel sequence is present in the PDF (pp. 33–40) and can be fully transcribed if needed.
